mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM second_hand_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND is_delete = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE second_hand_message SET status = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND status = 0 AND is_delete = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST(sender_id, receiver_id), GREATEST(sender_id, receiver_id)) FROM second_hand_message WHERE is_delete = 0 AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY LEAST(sender_id, receiver_id), GREATEST(sender_id, receiver_id) ORDER BY send_time DESC ) as row_num FROM second_hand_message WHERE is_delete = 0 AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) ) as t WHERE row_num = 1 ORDER BY send_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}
